requiredFindings.problem: Each of the twelve origin rows sets envelopeDetail to its internal diagnostic key. When a StepTermination omits domainDetail, envelopeErrorsComposition takes the failure CommandEnvelope errors entry from envelopeDetail, and every such code must be a member of the closed DomainDetailCode registry. PUBLIC_ROUTE_REMEDIES is keyed by that public code. native.closure-protocol-declaration-missing, native.closure-protocol-analyzer-mismatch, native.closure-protocol-descriptor-mismatch, and native.closure-protocol-unsupported are outside that enum. The successor does not supersede envelopeErrorsComposition. The native-evidence.md line 3558 after-text selects no new public detail member. The evidence check accepts the rows by validating a StepTermination that omits domainDetail and by requiring envelopeDetail to equal the internal key; that predicate does not satisfy the envelope composition.
